verses.en: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
verses.pt: E voltamos, e partimo-nos ao deserto caminho do mar Vermelho, como o SENHOR me havia dito; e rodeamos o monte de Seir por muitos dias.
verses.en_web: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.
verses.en_bbe: Then we went back, journeying into the waste land by the way to the Red Sea, as the Lord had said to me: and we were a long time going round Mount Seir.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,
verses.pt: E o SENHOR me falou, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to me,

verses.en: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
verses.pt: Demais rodeastes este monte; voltai-vos ao norte.
verses.en_web: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.
verses.en_bbe: You have been journeying round this mountain long enough: now go to the north;

verses.en: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
verses.pt: E manda ao povo, dizendo: Passando vós pelo termo de vossos irmãos os filhos de Esaú, que habitam em Seir, eles terão medo de vós; mas vós guardai-vos muito:
verses.en_web: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.
verses.en_bbe: And give the people orders, saying, You are about to go through the land of your brothers, the children of Esau, who are living in Seir; and they will have fear of you; so take care what you do:

verses.en: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a footbreadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
verses.pt: Não vos metais com eles; que não vos darei de sua terra nem ainda a pisadura da planta de um pé; porque eu dei por herança a Esaú o monte de Seir.
verses.en_web: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on; because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.
verses.en_bbe: Make no attack on them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even space enough for a man's foot: because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for his heritage.

verses.en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
verses.pt: Comprareis deles por dinheiro os alimentos, e comereis; e também comprareis deles a água, e bebereis:
verses.en_web: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”
verses.en_bbe: You may get food for your needs from them for a price, and water for drinking.

verses.en: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
verses.pt: Pois o SENHOR teu Deus te abençoou em toda obra de tuas mãos: ele sabe que andas por este grande deserto: estes quarenta anos o SENHOR teu Deus foi contigo; e nenhuma coisa te faltou.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hand. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
verses.en_bbe: For the blessing of the Lord your God has been on you in all the work of your hands: he has knowledge of your wanderings through this great waste: these forty years the Lord your God has been with you, and you have been short of nothing.

verses.en: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.pt: E passamos por nossos irmãos os filhos de Esaú, que habitavam em Seir, pelo caminho da planície de Elate e de Eziom-Geber. E voltamos, e passamos caminho do deserto de Moabe.
verses.en_web: So we passed by from our brothers the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.en_bbe: So we went on past our brothers, the children of Esau, living in Seir, by the road through the Arabah, from Elath and Ezion-geber. And turning, we went by the road through the waste land of Moab.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR me disse: Não perturbeis a Moabe, nem te empenhes com eles em guerra, que não te darei possessão de sua terra; porque eu dei a Ar por herança aos filhos de Ló.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession; because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to me, Make no attack on Moab and do not go to war with them, for I will not give you any of his land: because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for their heritage.

verses.en: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
verses.pt: (Os emins habitaram nela antes, povo grande, e numeroso, e alto como gigantes:
verses.en_web: (The Emim lived therein before, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakim.
verses.en_bbe: (In the past the Emim were living there; a great people, equal in numbers to the Anakim and as tall;

verses.en: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
verses.pt: Por gigantes eram eles também contados, como os anaquins; e os moabitas os chamam emins.
verses.en_web: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.
verses.en_bbe: They are numbered among the Rephaim, like the Anakim; but are named Emim by the Moabites.

verses.en: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
verses.pt: E em Seir habitaram antes os horeus, aos quais os filhos de Esaú expulsaram; e os destruíram de diante de si, e moraram em lugar deles; como fez Israel na terra de sua possessão que lhes deu o SENHOR.)
verses.en_web: The Horites also lived in Seir before, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place; as Israel did to the land of his possession, which Yahweh gave to them.)
verses.en_bbe: And the Horites in earlier times were living in Seir, but the children of Esau took their place; they sent destruction on them and took their land for themselves, as Israel did to the land of his heritage which the Lord gave them.)

verses.en: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
verses.pt: Levantai-vos agora, e passai o ribeiro de Zerede. E passamos o ribeiro de Zerede.
verses.en_web: “Now rise up, and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.
verses.en_bbe: Get up now, and go over the stream Zered. So we went over the stream Zered.

verses.en: And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.
verses.pt: E os dias que andamos de Cades-Barneia até que passamos o ribeiro de Zerede, foram trinta e oito anos; até que se acabou toda a geração dos homens de guerra do meio do acampamento, como o SENHOR lhes havia jurado.
verses.en_web: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea, until we had come over the brook Zered, were thirty-eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.
verses.en_bbe: Thirty-eight years had gone by from the time when we came away from Kadesh-barnea till we went over the stream Zered; by that time all the generation of the men of war among us were dead, as the Lord had said.

verses.en: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
verses.pt: E também a mão do SENHOR foi sobre eles para destruí-los do meio do campo, até acabá-los.
verses.en_web: Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.
verses.en_bbe: For the hand of the Lord was against them, working their destruction, till all were dead.

verses.en: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.pt: E aconteceu que quando se acabaram de morrer todos os homens de guerra dentre o povo,
verses.en_web: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.en_bbe: So when death had overtaken all the men of war among the people,

verses.en: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,
verses.pt: O SENHOR me falou, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
verses.pt: Tu passarás hoje o termo de Moabe, a Ar,
verses.en_web: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.
verses.en_bbe: You are about to go by Ar, the limit of the country of Moab;

verses.en: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.pt: E te aproximarás diante dos filhos de Amom: não os perturbeis, nem te metas com eles; porque não te tenho de dar possessão da terra dos filhos de Amom; que aos filhos de Ló a dei por herança.
verses.en_web: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession; because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”
verses.en_bbe: And when you come near the land of the children of Ammon, give them no cause of trouble and do not make war on them, for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for your heritage: because I have given it to the children of Lot.

verses.en: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
verses.pt: (Por terra de gigantes foi também ela tida: habitaram nela gigantes em outro tempo, aos quais os amonitas chamavam zanzumins;
verses.en_web: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim: Rephaim lived there before; but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,
verses.en_bbe: (That land is said to have been a land of the Rephaim, for Rephaim had been living there in earlier times, but they were named Zamzummim by the Ammonites;

verses.en: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
verses.pt: Povo grande, e numeroso, e alto, como os anaquins; aos quais o SENHOR destruiu de diante dos amonitas, os quais lhes sucederam, e habitaram em seu lugar:
verses.en_web: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place;
verses.en_bbe: They were a great people, tall as the Anakim, and equal to them in number; but the Lord sent destruction on them and the children of Ammon took their place, living in their land;

verses.en: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
verses.pt: Como fez com os filhos de Esaú, que habitavam em Seir, de diante dos quais destruiu aos horeus; e eles lhes sucederam, e habitaram em seu lugar até hoje.
verses.en_web: as he did for the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day:
verses.en_bbe: As he did for the children of Esau living in Seir, when he sent destruction on the Horites before them, and they took their land where they are living to this day:

verses.en: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
verses.pt: E aos aveus que habitavam em vilas até Gaza, os caftoreus que saíram de Caftor os destruíram, e habitaram em seu lugar.)
verses.en_web: and the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and lived in their place.)
verses.en_bbe: And the Avvim, living in the small towns as far as Gaza, came to destruction by the hands of the Caphtorim who came out from Caphtor and took their land.)

verses.en: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.pt: Levantai-vos, parti, e passai o ribeiro de Arnom: eis que dei em tua mão a Seom rei de Hesbom, amorreu, e a sua terra: começa a tomar possessão, e empenha-te com ele em guerra.
verses.en_web: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon: behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.en_bbe: Get up now, and go on your journey, crossing over the valley of the Arnon: see, I have given into your hands Sihon, the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and all his land: go forward to make it yours, and make war on him,

verses.en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
verses.pt: Hoje começarei a pôr teu medo e teu espanto sobre os povos debaixo de todo o céu, os quais ouvirão tua fama, e tremerão, e se angustiarão diante de ti.
verses.en_web: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of you.”
verses.en_bbe: From now on I will put the fear of you in all peoples under heaven, who, hearing of you, will be shaking with fear and grief of heart because of you.

verses.en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.pt: E enviei mensageiros desde o deserto de Quedemote a Seom rei de Hesbom, com palavras de paz, dizendo:
verses.en_web: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then from the waste land of Kedemoth I sent representatives to Sihon, king of Heshbon, with words of peace, saying,

verses.en: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
verses.pt: Passarei por tua terra pelo caminho: pelo caminho irei, sem apartar-me à direita nem à esquerda:
verses.en_web: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway, I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.
verses.en_bbe: Let me go through your land: I will keep to the highway, not turning to the right or to the left;

verses.en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
verses.pt: A comida me venderás por dinheiro e comerei: a água também me darás por dinheiro, e beberei: somente passarei a pé;
verses.en_web: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,
verses.en_bbe: Let me have food, at a price, for my needs, and water for drinking: only let me go through on foot;

verses.en: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.
verses.pt: Como o fizeram comigo os filhos de Esaú que habitavam em Seir, e os moabitas que habitavam em Ar; até que passe o Jordão à terra que nos dá o SENHOR nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me; until I pass over the Jordan into the land which Yahweh our God gives us.”
verses.en_bbe: As the children of Esau did for me in Seir and the Moabites in Ar; till I have gone over Jordan into the land which the Lord our God is giving us.

verses.en: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
verses.pt: Mas Seom rei de Hesbom não quis que passássemos pelo território seu; porque o SENHOR teu Deus havia endurecido seu espírito, e obstinado seu coração para entregá-lo em tua mão, como hoje.
verses.en_web: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.
verses.en_bbe: But Sihon, king of Heshbon, would not let us go through; for the Lord your God made his spirit hard and his heart strong, so that he might give him up into your hands as at this day.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
verses.pt: E disse-me o SENHOR: Eis que eu comecei a dar diante de ti a Seom e a sua terra; começa a tomar possessão, para que herdes sua terra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to me, See, from now on I have given Sihon and his land into your hands: go forward now to take his land and make it yours.

verses.en: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
verses.pt: E saiu-nos Seom ao encontro, ele e todo seu povo, para lutar em Jaza.
verses.en_web: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.
verses.en_bbe: Then Sihon came out against us with all his people, to make an attack on us at Jahaz.

verses.en: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.pt: Mas o SENHOR nosso Deus o entregou diante de nós; e ferimos a ele e a seus filhos, e a todo seu povo.
verses.en_web: Yahweh our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord our God gave him into our hands; and we overcame him and his sons and all his people.

verses.en: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
verses.pt: E tomamos então todas suas cidades, e destruímos todas as cidades, homens, e mulheres, e crianças; não deixamos ninguém:
verses.en_web: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.
verses.en_bbe: At that time we took all his towns, and gave them over to complete destruction, together with men, women, and children; we had no mercy on any:

verses.en: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
verses.pt: Somente tomamos para nós os animais, e os despojos das cidades que havíamos tomado.
verses.en_web: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.
verses.en_bbe: Only the cattle we took for ourselves, with the goods from the towns we had taken.

verses.en: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:
verses.pt: Desde Aroer, que está junto à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e a cidade que está no ribeiro, até Gileade, não houve cidade que escapasse de nós: todas as entregou o SENHOR nosso Deus em nosso poder.
verses.en_web: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.
verses.en_bbe: From Aroer on the edge of the valley of the Arnon and from the town in the valley as far as Gilead, no town was strong enough to keep us out; the Lord our God gave them all into our hands:

verses.en: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.
verses.pt: Somente à terra dos filhos de Amom não chegaste, nem a tudo o que está à beira do ribeiro de Jaboque nem às cidades do monte, nem a lugar algum que o SENHOR nosso Deus havia proibido.
verses.en_web: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near; all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever Yahweh our God forbade us.
verses.en_bbe: But you did not go near the land of the children of Ammon, that is, all the side of the river Jabbok or the towns of the hill-country, wherever the Lord our God had said we were not to go.
